entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Test plan for "ternary comparison operator" feature #83255

Closed

  • Completions inside property pattern force-completes a member even if current name represents another one #82606
